zh.title: 个人介绍
zh.name: 钟泓瑨（Hongjin Zhong）
zh.affiliation: 中山大学计算机学院 / 2023 级本科生
paragraphs: 我是中山大学计算机学院计算机科学与技术专业的大四本科生。目前，我在清华大学交叉信息研究院（IIIS）的 IDEAL 实验室实习，由高鸣宇教授指导。我也是中山大学超算队（SYSU-SCC）的成员。我在 ISC 2025 国际大学生超算竞赛中担任队长，获得线上赛冠军

en.title: About
en.name: Hongjin Zhong (钟泓瑨)
paragraphs: I am a fourth-year undergraduate majoring in Computer Science and Technology at the School of Computer Science and Engineering, Sun Yat-sen University. I am currently interning at the IDEAL Lab in Tsinghua University's Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences (IIIS) advised by Prof. Mingyu Gao. I am also a member of Sun Yat-sen University's supercomputing team (SYSU-SCC). Our team won first place in the online track of the ISC 2025 Student Cluster Competition, with me serving as team captain.
